reviews.comment: Love this guy! Hard to understand and lectures were useless. Learning online is definitely the move but Manish is the goat. Highly recommend. He's getting better at teaching since the bad ratings were from his first year teaching.

Unfortunately one of the worst professors I have ever had. His lectures consist solely of solving example problems with often illegible handwriting. His explanations are either useless, or just cause more confusion. He is a researcher, not a professor.

My advice: watch the Jeff Hansen statics videos on Youtube and check your projects with the TAs

First time ever teaching a class, very slow pace, hard to understand speaking or writing. Nice and tries hard but overall not a good choice for a class which is difficult and requires lots of work. Take someone else if you can, or you will spend the semester watching Jeff Hanson as your professor. Textbook is pretty worthless, HW is time consuming.

If you're going to take his class, please do it with friends because it makes it so much better. I could not go through it alone. Our recitation table trauma bonded over how little we knew, and that was the highlight of this course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Vasoya is not a good professor. His handwriting is borderline illegible and his class is very difficult. There is a ton of homework and he does not do a good job of teaching the material at all, I had to learn it all on my own. Class is paced slow but we still somehow don't learn anything. I would recommend trying for Dr. Cope at all costs.

PLEASE DO NOT LISTEN TO THE 5 REVIEWS, This professor is one of the worst professors I have ever taken. We learned nothing in this class and I learned more from Jeff Hanson on YT. Recitations are 2 hours long and you will get through 4 questions MAX. He is very funny and is a good guy but his teaching is not up to scratch with people like Dr Cope.
Watch Jeff Hanson YT channel instead of going to class.

reviews.comment: Dude the guy below me is speaking facts. Anyone that give this man a 5 is just yappin. Manish is a nice guy, but not good at lectures. I would recommend skipping lecture and watchign Jeff Hanson, because there is genuinely no point. He writes chicken scratch and overcomplicates problems for most of the class then leaves. Don't recommend

Although Manish seems like a nice person, his lectures are very difficult to understand. There seems to be no structure whatsoever in lectures. Assignments are strung across 4 different websites, and it is sometimes not clear what we are even supposed to do, especially for the classroom participation. Test average was about a 70. Better options.

Dr.V has a little bit of an accent and english is not his first language, so it's a little hard to understand him. However, he is super super nice, letting you take an exam with another section. The class is already hard, but tbh Dr. Cope is still the GOAT. His partial credit system is funky and the exam averages were ~70s.
professor vasoya is highly knowledgeable, but the pace of the course could be challenging.

Professor Vasoya is a gem in the meen department. Their lectures are exemplary, characterized by a perfect blend of clarity and passion. Approachable during office hours, they navigate the labyrinth of equations with patience and expertise, making the learning experience not just educational but genuinely enjoyable. Easy A would retake

This is a hard class to begin with and the amount of work given was unnecessarily long. Lecture abilities and knowledge learned from lectures were sub-par and most of my learning came from the practice problems and outside sources.
